literal: The help a son performs for his father is the word saying, 'What penance did this man's father perform?'
translation: The greatest benefit a son can confer upon his father is to act so virtuously that others wonder, 'What great penance must his father have performed to beget such a son?'
modern: ஒரு மகன் தன் தந்தைக்குச் செய்யக்கூடிய சிறந்த உதவி, 'இவனுடைய தந்தை இவனைப் பெறுவதற்கு என்ன தவம் செய்தாரோ!' என்று பிறர் வியந்து கூறும் சொல்லாகும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the ultimate duty and gift a child can offer to their parents. The greatest 'help' (உதவி) a son can render is not material wealth, but living a life of such virtue and excellence that others praise his father. When people see the son's noble character, they should wonder aloud what great penance (நோற்றான்) the father must have performed to deserve such a child. This public admiration (சொல்) is the highest honor a child can bestow.
